CompanyDescription.label: Company Description
CompanyDescription.value: TTM Technologies, Inc. is a leading global manufacturer of technology products, including mission systems, radio frequency ('RF') components, RF microwave/microelectronic assemblies, and technologically advanced interconnect products, including PCBs and substrates. TTM stands for time-to-market, representing how TTM's time-critical, one-stop design, engineering and manufacturing services enable customers to reduce the time required to develop new products and bring them to market.
